dct_description_sm:
Each year, an annual work schedule is prepared in accordance with the Forest Management Planning Manual. This schedule outlines the forest operations that will be carried out in the upcoming year for each forest management plan. The associated spatial information is exchanged following the Forest Information Manual, Annual Work Schedule Technical Specifications, which define the required data standards (e.g., attributes, formats) for spatial information related to annual activities such as harvest operations, road construction and use, water crossings, and regeneration treatments.

For additional Annual Work Schedule information including text and maps, the Forest Information Manual recognizes the Natural Resources Information Portal (NRIP) as the official method for transferring and storing source information.  A single Annual Work Schedule feature service is created for each forest management plan.
